title: Pipe chart PDF and photos for the open run
description:
The pipe chart can now open the report PDF and photos that belong to the inspection you have open — not every file in the package. After a billable package is built with Videos/Reports/Images, opening a run’s video shows photo marks on the pipe at their chainage and offers View PDF / View Photos only when those files are linked to that run.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing WinCan packages on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: View PDF and View Photos buttons appear on the pipe chart only when that run has matching files.
Photo marks show on the pipe at WinCan observation chainages for linked images.
PDF and photo viewers open without losing the selected inspection video.
